scope: Source-pinned capture constancy and structured control-flow equivalence for two next_sound callback literals; not installed, not native execution and not battle qualification.
checks: Current next_sound captured once before guard
Captured i read before Delay getter; relational coercion retained
playSound read only after both earlier guards
Current ed.playBattleEffect resolved before SoundName getter and called with ed receiver
Call completes before index read, numeric coercion and write
Current phase and sound_list read after increment; list resolved before CURRENT index read
Exceptions preserve exact completed prefix and sentinel identity
Negative zero, NaN, Infinity, strings, BigInt and object numeric coercion retained

executionGraph.operation: Read lexical i, Get(e,Delay), relational i>Delay including ToPrimitive order
Read current ed; Get(ed,playBattleEffect); Get(e,SoundName); Call with this=ed
Get(this,next_sound_idx); ToNumeric; add matching Number/BigInt one; Set(this,next_sound_idx)
Resolve this.next_sound reference; Get(this,current_phase); Get(phase,sound_list); Get(this,next_sound_idx); ToPropertyKey; Get(list,key); Set(this,next_sound)

admissionContract.captureI: Binding constancy proven at both creation sites in the pinned source. Initializer + yields a primitive; a future f64-only ABI must still guard typeof i===number and preserve exact bits.
admissionContract.receiver: Must retain exact bound receiver strongly, not reconstruct from target identity.
admissionContract.environment: ed is read at dispatch; property getters, proxies and mutation remain observable. Never cache effect method, index, phase or sound_list across earlier observable operations.
admissionContract.creation: Current source invokes callback.bind(this) through dynamic property lookup before clientCall. Rewriting creation must preserve builtin bind identity/fallback and logical callback identity/own descriptors/prototypes/source.
admissionContract.queue: Retain original FIFO captured-array drain and every logical before/after event.

blockers: Existing public target resolver deliberately exposes only GetBoundFunction target, not bound receiver/arguments or lexical environment. It cannot populate a sound callback enum faithfully.
No source-creation-site environment/callback representation with original function identity and source/descriptor fallback is integrated. A target hash alone cannot replace this closure.
Even with primitive constant i, receiver and ed remain live object identities and original accessor/coercion/exception order must remain; the structured form is a proof artifact, not a fast path.
